channel.title: CIS 505 - Introduction to Programming Languages :: CS Two Year Refactor
channel.description: Course Description History, programming language concepts including type, scope and extent, abstraction mechanisms and control; programming paradigms, including one or more of logic, functional, and object-oriented programming, and programming languages supporting the selected paradigms; interpreters, compilers and virtual machines for the selected languages; storage management and garbage collection; type checking and type inference. Credit Hours 3 credits Course Overview Not yet drafted — pending course-designer’s detailed pass. resources/reference/degree-maps/cs.md (2026-07-14) confirms this course is “leaning required” — not fully settled, but no longer just “may become an elective” — and is the confirmed home for most of the core’s formal-language content (grammars, parsing), anchoring the ABET “computer science theory” formal-languages sub-area.
